name: CraftBench
intro: CraftBench 不是独立评测集，而是 Agent World Model（AWM）论文附录表 15 中的 Custom Manufacturing Job Tracker 场景，官方场景 ID 为 manufacturing_execution_system_1。固定官方记录进一步公开了该场景的 10 个任务、18 张表、114 条初始插入和 50 个端点；构建沿用 AWM 通用合成流程，但没有 CraftBench 专属划分、提示、评测程序或指标。
build_method: 以 100 个热门域名为种子，经 Self-Instruct 扩展、CRUD 分类、嵌入去重（实现只剔除余弦相似度 > 0.85 的候选，即保留 ≤ 0.85）和类别上限得到 1,000 个场景；每场景生成 10 个 API 可解、登录后的任务。SQLite 模式、样例数据和环境代码分别执行并形成反馈环：模式与数据失败率 < 10% 才接受，环境启动错误须为 0%；traceback 由独立 LLM 压缩为 200–500 tokens 后回灌，组件最多重试 5 次并保留最低错误率尝试
metric: 无独立 CraftBench 指标；AWM 任务奖励为完成 1.0、部分完成 0.1、其他 0.0，工具调用格式错误时步骤奖励为 −1 并提前终止
eval_feature: 独立智能体评测分支同时把智能体轨迹与任务验证器给出的结构化验证信号送入代码增强 GPT-5 判分器；不是 CraftBench 专属评测
scale: CraftBench 官方记录：10 个任务、18 张表、114 条初始插入、18 个 API 组与 50 个端点；AWM 全集为 1,000 个环境、10,000 个任务
build_method_en: Seed 100 popular domains; expand with Self-Instruct; apply a CRUD classifier, embedding de-duplication that rejects only cosine similarity > 0.85 (therefore retaining ≤ 0.85), and category caps; then generate 10 API-solvable post-authentication tasks per scenario. SQLite schema, sample data, and environment code each have execution feedback loops: schema/data are accepted only below 10% failure and environment startup requires 0% error; a separate LLM compresses traceback into 200–500 tokens for regeneration, for up to five attempts before retaining the lowest-error attempt
eval_feature_en: A separate agent-evaluation branch sends both the agent trajectory and structured verification signals from the task verifier to a code-augmented GPT-5 judge; not a CraftBench-specific evaluation
intro_en: CraftBench is not a standalone evaluation set. It is the Custom Manufacturing Job Tracker scenario, official id manufacturing_execution_system_1, sampled in Agent World Model Appendix Table 15. The pinned official record further publishes 10 tasks, 18 tables, 114 initial inserts and 50 endpoints. It follows the AWM-wide synthesis pipeline but has no CraftBench-specific split, prompt, evaluation harness or metric.
scale_en: Pinned CraftBench record: 10 tasks, 18 tables, 114 initial inserts, 18 API groups and 50 endpoints; AWM overall: 1,000 environments and 10,000 tasks
metric_en: No standalone CraftBench metric; AWM task reward is 1.0 for Completed, 0.1 for Partially Completed and 0.0 otherwise; a tool-call format violation receives step reward −1 and terminates the rollout

drawio_review_note: Aligned with Agent World Model arXiv:2602.10090v3 §3.1, §3.2, and §3.3 plus Appendix Table 15; fixed official sources are Snowflake-Labs/agent-world-model full commit 85e322f69279e3b3325b7377ec3bab788514e9cb and Snowflake/AgentWorldModel-1K revision dde80a0283fe781bdc51656bce57063dc5650213. CraftBench is the Custom Manufacturing Job Tracker record with exact scenario id manufacturing_execution_system_1. The implementation rejects only embedding pairs above 0.85, so the diagram states that cosine similarity ≤ 0.85 is retained. The schema feedback loop executes DDL and accepts <10% failures, the sample data feedback loop executes INSERTs and accepts <10% failures, and the environment feedback loop launches the server, checks health and lists tools with a 0% startup-error requirement; each sends full traceback through a separate 200–500-token LLM summary, regenerates up to five times, and then keeps the lowest-error attempt. The separate agent-evaluation branch sends both agent trajectory and structured verification signals to the code-augmented GPT-5 judge. The pinned record contains 10 tasks, 18 tables, 114 initial INSERT rows, 18 API groups, and 50 endpoints. It has no standalone CraftBench split, prompt, evaluation harness, or metric; Completed 1.0, Partially Completed 0.1, otherwise 0.0 and format-error −1 early termination are AWM training rewards only.
